note: Set A is significantly better at capturing precise engineering values (e.g., 10'-0 1/2", 2'-0 3/8") whereas Set B frequently truncates these to feet only (10'-0, 2'-0). Set B also misidentifies grid lines as detail references (6, 3.A7) and truncates keynote numbers (31 13.A7, 11 23). Set A has one clear invention regarding PVC material for cables (conflating two notes) and some redundant claims with minor quote errors, but its data fidelity is much higher.
